This DPU implements range processing using hardware accelerator(HWA) and DSP.

RangeProc DDMA DPU

Description

Range Processing Unit takes RF data in ADC buffer, performs DC estimation and subtraction, interference estimation and mitigation, and computes 1D FFT and saves results in radarCube in compressed format.

Range Processing includes HWA implementations:

Device DPU runs on core Uses HWA
awr294x DSP Yes
awr2x44p DSS_CM4 Yes
